paths.flow: body/traits/care needs -> personal state -> task exclusion or later consequence
paths.time_failure_aftermath_limit: Daily or task-specific played time; conditional illness, aging and care aftermath.
paths.decision: Keep a follower supplied or ask them to work
paths.prerequisites: Supported body/task, actual home/care state and declared traits
paths.real_spend: Actor time and actual care/food when a consumer requires it
paths.state_mutation: Individual state, age, thoughts and daily claims
paths.downstream_consumer: Task availability, needs, housing/care and later bodily outcome
paths.time_policy: Per-task played-time rates and day boundaries
paths.failure: Untreated state, neglect, age or unsupported work
paths.later_aftermath: Retained identity/care history and named condition

paths.flow: personal need -> eligible role -> actual actor/site reservation -> interruption/reselection
paths.time_failure_aftermath_limit: Shared location task selection; unavailable facilities block work.
paths.prerequisites: Personal need resolved; role/priority and available task/facility
paths.real_spend: One actor plus claimed facility/task capacity
paths.downstream_consumer: Worker executes one chosen task; unavailable tasks remain unfilled
paths.failure: Unavailable reservation or higher personal priority
paths.later_aftermath: Old task released/retained and explicit replacement

paths.flow: recipe/material custody -> paid queue/carrying -> worker progress -> stored output or explicit refund
paths.time_failure_aftermath_limit: Partial progress and missing-silo exceptions preserved.
paths.decision: Queue refinement or move farm supplies
paths.prerequisites: Actual recipe items, facility or originating silo
paths.real_spend: Recipe stock at enqueue; carried stock leaves storage
paths.state_mutation: Frozen output variant, progress, carrying and reservation flags
paths.downstream_consumer: Completed stored material or returned stock
paths.time_policy: Productivity-weighted saved progress; task abort boundaries
paths.failure: No ingredients/site; missing silo limits refund
paths.later_aftermath: Partial progress, conserved remaining custody and queue

paths.flow: affordability -> actual placement payment -> reserved worker slots -> target facility/state carryover
paths.time_failure_aftermath_limit: Work completion differs from unlock; no whole demolition/refund audit.
paths.prerequisites: Unlock/affordability, valid placement and worker slots
paths.real_spend: Actual construction items at placement, worker time
paths.state_mutation: Build site progress and eventual target definition
paths.time_policy: Worker progress and saved site threshold
paths.failure: Unaffordable placement returns before spend; occupancy blocks work
paths.later_aftermath: Inventory/queue/occupants survive site replacement; demolition/refund policies unread

paths.flow: community thought/confidence -> eligible individual dissent -> nearby transmission -> warning -> cure or theft/retained opponent
paths.time_failure_aftermath_limit: Phase/cadence/identity/gear exceptions and dormant Happiness branch preserved.
paths.decision: Respond to low confidence and a particular dissenter
paths.prerequisites: Community threshold, phase/cadence, personal exceptions; nearby speech or valid cure target
paths.real_spend: Actual available gold at departure; reeducation actor time
paths.state_mutation: Thought stacks, dissent state, warning/receiver IDs, departure record
paths.downstream_consumer: Faith display, task interruption, cure or retained named opponent
paths.time_policy: Thought expiry, pair contact interval and dissent timer
paths.failure: Unchecked dissent leaves; only timely eligible intervention cures
paths.later_aftermath: Actual bounded theft, identity/history and later encounter death

paths.flow: adoration -> uncapped earned level -> capped function consumers -> separate promoted office -> service
paths.time_failure_aftermath_limit: Current version differs from old capped-level patch notes.
paths.decision: Claim a level and separately appoint an office
paths.prerequisites: Adoration threshold; specific office requires level 10, no prior office and ritual availability
paths.real_spend: Named ritual stock and actor/ceremony availability
paths.state_mutation: Adoration reset/level increment; separate disciple status/created count
paths.downstream_consumer: Capped work/demon consumer or actual disciple reeducation service
paths.time_policy: Accumulation versus appointment are separate actions
paths.failure: No eligible candidate/affordability; obsolete helper must not supply a false cap
paths.later_aftermath: Retained level/title and actual resulting duties

paths.flow: policy unlock -> collective effect/ritual eligibility -> actual completion cost -> selected service/pressure
paths.time_failure_aftermath_limit: Cancelled/forced/free/night branches differ; no general consent inference.
paths.decision: Choose policy and perform a ritual
paths.prerequisites: Recorded unlock, candidate, cooldown and affordability; current policy
paths.real_spend: Successful normal ritual cost; forced/free/cancel cases differ
paths.state_mutation: Collective traits, unlocks, cooldown/result and free-use flag
paths.downstream_consumer: Work/food/season functions, ceremony-specific effects and objective
paths.time_policy: Current game cooldown and completion boundary
paths.failure: Rejected/absent candidate, cancellation or night disturbance
paths.later_aftermath: Actual policy identity, completed service and future modifiers

paths.flow: dead identity/remains -> resurrection/preparation history -> adverse state -> target-specific paid cure
paths.time_failure_aftermath_limit: No complete death, burial or save failure review; selected resurrection/care chain.
paths.decision: Restore a dead person or treat a current condition
paths.real_spend: Current ritual recipe or condition-specific medical stock
paths.downstream_consumer: Ordinary work/task restoration or remaining incomplete cure
paths.time_policy: Resurrection timing/history and named treatment effect
paths.failure: Possible post-return zombie/dread or doctrine-limited mutation removal
paths.later_aftermath: Same identity, preparation history, state and later care costs

paths.flow: actual recipe/meal -> reservation -> consumption -> independent effects -> body/work/affinity/cure consumer
paths.time_failure_aftermath_limit: Abort-after-bite, special risky outcome, doctrine/onboarding and overflow policy preserved.

paths.real_spend: One actual meal at arrival; recipe definitions require actual ingredients
paths.state_mutation: Food removed, satiation changed, selected effect or state
paths.downstream_consumer: Body, task, loyalty, care and waste/cure functions
paths.time_policy: Consumption/abort boundary and independent effect draw
paths.failure: Missing reservation ends; dangerous food has harmful outcomes
paths.later_aftermath: Condition/trait/age change and explicit abstract overflow policy

paths.flow: nearby conversation -> pair record -> friendship/romance/enmity -> intervention/fight or eligible offspring -> care/parent history
paths.time_failure_aftermath_limit: Parentage and body exceptions; source response/probability is not a consent model.

paths.real_spend: Actor interaction time; sin spent before a mating attempt
paths.state_mutation: Shared pair record, fight attribution, egg/parent/child data
paths.downstream_consumer: Later friendship/romance/enmity, injury/care or family state
paths.failure: Bad conversation, declined probability, injury/death or exceptional egg failure
paths.later_aftermath: Remembered pair state, named cause, parentage and care history

paths.flow: actual person/facility commitment -> frozen start/outcome -> due return -> delivered resource/recruit or death -> later trait/care effects
paths.time_failure_aftermath_limit: No reroll, known introductory guarantees and tier-condition anomaly; whole mission graph unread.
paths.prerequisites: Chosen actual person and facility; level/body/trait readiness
paths.real_spend: Actor availability and time; no invented universal coin cost
paths.state_mutation: Frozen start/duration/type/chance/outcome, then retained reward/return state
paths.downstream_consumer: Actually delivered normal stock/recruit or failed return death
paths.time_policy: Stored played-time due boundary and explicit settlement
paths.failure: Failure produces no reward and can end the person life
paths.later_aftermath: Removed mission occupancy; fatigue/experience affects later actions

paths.real_spend: Actual occupied actor role and later exhaustion; cargo loss where selected
paths.state_mutation: Support membership and functional level; inventory/run deltas
paths.downstream_consumer: Actual telegraphed demon combat and later restored home work
paths.time_policy: Combat timing, result settlement and supported home return
paths.failure: Escape/death differ; fragile stock can be lost; GameOver is another domain
paths.later_aftermath: Same person fatigue/history and adjusted cargo, not a full source reset

paths.flow: normal/skip frame delta -> active/unloaded actors -> task/body/world progress -> explicit stop-time option

paths.real_spend: Only declared task/body/world changes on supported simulated time

paths.downstream_consumer: Home work/people while player crusades or deliberate full simulation pause
paths.time_policy: Frame conversion, explicit skip, game-calendar pause and simulation pause differ

paths.state_mutation: Progress/received delivery, severity, fuel and condition/facility state

paths.time_policy: Season and played time with boss/body/upgrade/lock exceptions
paths.failure: Fuel exhaustion/cold/snow-covered facility; no invented mandatory offline loss
paths.later_aftermath: Warnings, changed work and new challenge after success

paths.flow: real habitat/feed/parents -> phase needs/readiness -> actual worker custody/output -> retained ailment/age/offspring

paths.downstream_consumer: Produced materials, milk, ordinary work and future care
paths.time_policy: Phases/days, target mating phase and explicit absent-player differences
paths.failure: Overcrowding, illness/feral state, age death, abort or missing animal
paths.later_aftermath: Named animal, saved parental parameters and conserved worker delivery
